pins.note: A build tool for the Unix PuTTY build, not an SSH implementation. It is a prebuilt binary distribution and is pulled into the toolchain directory rather than installed system-wide.

pins.digest_source: forensics/authorities/AUTHORITIES.json, artifact.checksum_verified = true (published_sha256 equals the observed sha256)

open_obligations: Dropbear's archive digest is a first-fetch pin. Its detached .asc is published but the signing key is not pinned in this repository, so the digest is not yet independently authenticated. Pinning the key and verifying the signature belongs to O3.
PuTTY's sha256sums list is itself signed (sha256sums.asc) and that signature is likewise not verified here.
The OpenSSL authority archive is verified by the authorities registry, not by this manifest; the manifest repeats its digest so a build can bind to one value.
